blockingGates: SharnouDevAgent has no qualified in-process local inference runtime that can generate source patches.
Typed workspace patch/apply/rollback tools are not implemented as an active native DevAgent capability.
The native process broker and durable restart-recovery security gates remain unaccepted; model-facing process execution is disabled.
A native GitHub repository adapter with protected credentials and exact-head artifact retrieval is not yet implemented.
An exact-head Windows PowerShell 5.1 qualification result for GFX-0.2 has not been confirmed.

milestones.title: Graphics compiler architecture
deliverables: Review the architecture proposal, component boundaries, SGIR/1 interface and native-compiler versus shader-compiler boundary.
Resolve review findings and update the architecture decision record without changing approved compiler dependencies.
Produce a reviewed dependency and acceptance map for the shader and asset analysis workstreams.
acceptanceGates: Architecture review records accepted/rejected decisions and unresolved questions.
The shader compiler, asset analyzer and native PE compiler responsibilities remain distinct.
All later milestones have explicit dependencies, source ownership, acceptance tests and runtime evidence rules.
hardStops: Do not represent the draft architecture as accepted or implemented.
Do not approve DXC, Clang, MSVC, external compiler execution or an implicit D3DCompiler runtime dependency.

milestones.title: SGIR/1 schema and verifier
deliverables: Finish exact-head PowerShell 5.1 validation and fix every failing SGIR/1 test.
Freeze SGIR/1 canonical serialization, schema, type rules, resource contract and CFG/SSA invariants.
Produce a malformed-IR negative corpus, deterministic content hashes and a hash-bound qualification artifact.
acceptanceGates: All SGIR positive, negative, malformed JSON, schema, CFG, SSA, determinism and canonical-output tests pass on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
The existing compiler Test.ps1 gate passes on the same exact commit.
The evidence manifest binds the tested commit, source hashes, test outcomes and artifact digest.
hardStops: Do not start GFX-0.3 until GFX-0.1 and GFX-0.2 have been reviewed and accepted.
Do not claim Windows CI success from static JSON parsing or from the presence of a workflow file.

milestones.title: Shader lexer, parser and typed AST
deliverables: Define a small explicit .shshader grammar and stage/entry-point declarations.
Implement source-mapped lexing, parsing, AST construction, symbol scopes and typed declarations.
Lower accepted AST nodes into the frozen SGIR/1 contract without bypassing its verifier.
acceptanceGates: Positive grammar corpus covers declarations, functions, structs, scalar/vector/matrix expressions and vertex/pixel entry points.
Negative corpus checks malformed tokens, syntax, duplicate symbols, invalid scopes, type errors and exact line/column spans.
Every emitted SGIR module passes the independent SGIR/1 verifier; invalid source emits no SGIR artifact.
hardStops: Do not silently accept unsupported syntax or insert implicit narrowing conversions.
Do not duplicate SGIR validation inside IDE-only code.

milestones.title: Shader semantic and static analysis
deliverables: Implement typed-AST and verified-SGIR semantic checks for stage interfaces, types, resource bindings and constant-buffer declarations.
Add shader hazards for derivatives, invalid sampling, undefined values, numeric edge cases and unsupported target features.
Generate stable source-located diagnostic records with remediation and evidence-backed cost estimates.
acceptanceGates: Every diagnostic has a stable code, severity, source range, affected symbol and remediation.
Positive and negative fixtures cover stage/resource/type/layout semantics and unsupported capabilities.
Performance analysis is explicitly labelled estimated unless obtained from an actual GPU measurement.
hardStops: Do not report estimated shader cost as measured GPU time, occupancy or hardware register count.
Do not permit unsupported required effects to be silently downgraded.

milestones.title: D3D11 lowering and shader reflection
deliverables: Implement deterministic lowering from verified SGIR/1 into the approved D3D11 shader input representation.
Generate precise stage, resource and constant-buffer metadata for the backend.
Reflect compiled shader objects and compare actual inputs, outputs, register bindings and constant-buffer layouts with Sharnou's contract.
acceptanceGates: Backend positive and negative fixtures cover supported and rejected SGIR operations.
Backend reflection exactly matches the expected Sharnou stage/resource/constant-buffer contract.
Failed lowering or reflection cannot publish a shader package or replace a last-known-good cache entry.
hardStops: No DXC, Clang, MSVC, fxc.exe, dxc.exe or arbitrary compiler subprocess.
No D3DCompiler_47.dll dependency until its exact deployment/runtime policy receives an explicit owner decision.
requiredOwnerDecisions: Decide whether to approve an in-process D3DCompiler_47.dll D3DCompile/D3DReflect bridge for the D3D11 SM5 target or require a Sharnou-owned alternative.

milestones.title: Actual shader execution and indexed 3D mesh
deliverables: Load verified runtime shader packages through the Sharnou Engine D3D11 device/resource ownership layer.
Create vertex and index buffers, input layout, shaders, viewport, depth target and camera transforms.
Draw an actual indexed 3D mesh and capture deterministic runtime evidence.
acceptanceGates: The native Sharnou Engine executable creates and validates the actual D3D11 resources and shader objects.
A real indexed mesh draw produces verified pixels; a clear/present-only loop is insufficient.
Capture records executable, shader package, source asset, GPU adapter, driver, display mode, scene settings and output hashes.
hardStops: Do not claim a mesh render from a static screenshot, generated image or clear/present test.
Do not use WARP-only results as proof of high-performance physical-GPU performance.

milestones.title: glTF/GLB geometry and scene analyzer
deliverables: Implement bounded glTF JSON and GLB container parsing.
Validate buffers, buffer views, accessors, index bounds, primitive topology, node transforms, hierarchy, materials and required extensions.
Analyze mesh positions, normals, tangents, UVs, bounds, winding, skin attributes and geometry-memory estimates.
acceptanceGates: Positive and negative corpus includes GLB chunk errors, accessor overflows, bad indices, non-finite geometry, invalid hierarchy and unsupported required extensions.
All length, offset, alignment and multiplication arithmetic is overflow checked before allocation or indexing.
Analysis output is deterministic, source-located and read-only against imported assets.
hardStops: Reject unknown required glTF extensions instead of silently dropping content.
Do not claim successful GPU upload, rendering or transcoding from structural parsing alone.

milestones.title: KTX2 and PBR material analyzer
deliverables: Implement bounded KTX2 header, level-index, metadata and DFD parsing.
Validate KHR_texture_basisu references, texture dimensions, levels, faces, layers, payload ranges and supercompression metadata.
Analyze PBR material slots, texture color spaces, normal/roughness/metallic/AO channel conventions and sampler compatibility.
acceptanceGates: Positive and negative KTX2 fixtures cover malformed headers, overflowed ranges, invalid DFD/level metadata and unsupported required formats.
PBR checks validate glTF material references and distinguish required from optional texture inputs.
The analyzer never reports successful Basis transcoding or GPU upload unless a separately accepted runtime path performs and verifies it.
hardStops: Do not substitute AVIF for 3D KTX2 material textures.
Do not add an unapproved third-party transcoder or download a compiler/toolchain.

milestones.title: Skeleton and animation analyzer
deliverables: Validate skin joints, skeleton hierarchy, inverse-bind matrices, joint indices and normalized skin weights.
Validate animation samplers, input/output accessors, interpolation modes, channel targets and duration ranges.
Cross-check animation targets against the parsed scene and skeleton and produce deterministic diagnostics.
acceptanceGates: Positive and negative fixtures cover valid skins, missing joints, bad weights, invalid matrices, out-of-range channels and incompatible target nodes.
Animation channel and accessor references resolve against the validated glTF asset graph.
No invented or silently repaired skeleton/animation links are emitted.
hardStops: Do not mark animation runtime support complete from data parsing or metadata inspection.
Do not change the imported source asset during analysis.

milestones.title: Sharnou IDE graphics workbench
deliverables: Integrate shader source diagnostics, SGIR inspection and compilation stage status using the same compiler/analyzer libraries as command-line builds.
Add resource/constant-buffer viewers, glTF hierarchy and mesh inspection, KTX2/PBR inspection and skeleton/animation views.
Provide a real D3D11 preview surface and visible fallback/capability state.
acceptanceGates: IDE diagnostics match command-line diagnostics for the same source revision.
Views consume versioned structured compiler/analyzer outputs and do not reimplement shader or asset semantics.
Preview labels actual GPU execution, reduced capability and fallback materials accurately.
hardStops: Do not add an independent UI-only shader parser.
Do not describe a static mock preview as a functioning GPU viewport.

milestones.title: GPU profiling and rendering optimization
deliverables: Add non-blocking timestamp/disjoint query rings around actual render passes.
Measure CPU submission and GPU execution times with adapter/driver/scene metadata.
Add per-pass diagnostics for draw count, triangles, shader changes, resource memory and measured bottlenecks, then optimize only after a repeatable baseline exists.
acceptanceGates: Timestamp deltas are accepted only when the corresponding disjoint query is valid.
GPU query polling is asynchronous and does not force a per-frame CPU/GPU stall.
Before/after optimization reports use the same scene, camera, adapter, driver and capture settings and contain measured results.
hardStops: Do not report estimates as measured GPU time or occupancy.
Do not optimize from synthetic counters or unreproducible scene captures.

globalAcceptance: The native DevAgent must load and validate this campaign as data; milestone state cannot be inferred from a title, PR label or model assertion.
A milestone becomes windows_qualified only when an exact-head Windows result and its hash-bound evidence artifact have been retrieved and verified.
A milestone becomes accepted only after its acceptance gates pass and an owner/reviewer accepts the draft PR; the agent never merges or releases.
Every generation runs in an isolated worktree with a baseline hash, allowlisted paths, bounded patch sizes, bounded repair attempts and automatic rollback on any failed mandatory gate.
The frozen M1-M6 83-case provenance issue remains separate; do not claim its coverage on a branch that does not contain and execute the exact baseline sources.
No graphics milestone may introduce MSVC, Clang, Visual Studio, MSBuild, external shader compiler executables, arbitrary command execution or unapproved compiler/runtime dependencies.
Runtime rendering and profiling milestones require genuine Windows execution and physical-GPU evidence where specified; static validators and WARP-only tests are not substitutes.

Design-only milestones may use deterministic document/schema checks, but must not be described as Windows runtime acceptance; code-bearing milestones require exact-head Windows evidence where the manifest says so.
